args.summary: checkout-api was failing health checks (error rate 0.18) after the v2.3.1 deploy. Rolled back to v2.3.0 (the most recent healthy production release) in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rollback verified.

trace.final:
I rolled back checkout-api to v2.3.0 (the most recent healthy production release) in all regions and opened a SEV2 incident.

**What I did:**
1. **Diagnosed** — `get_service_status` showed checkout-api on v2.3.1, unhealthy, with an 18% error rate across all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west).
2. **Identified the target** — `list_deployments` showed v2.3.0 was the last healthy production release (v2.3.1 was unhealthy).
3. **Rolled back** — rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all production regions; the rollback was verified.
4. **Opened incident** — created SEV2 incident `INC-0001` for checkout-api, paging on-call, describing the failure and the rollback.
